working: Assuming μr = 1, v = c/√εr = 3×10^8/3 = 10^8 m/s, so (1) is correct. Since ω = 2π×10^6, f = 10^6 Hz and λ = v/f = 100 m, not 300 m. So (2) is incorrect. The phase (kz − ωt) means the wave travels along +z, so (4) is correct. For E along x and propagation along +z, B lies along y with amplitude E0/v. (3) as printed says B0/v, which looks like a typo for E0/v; read that way it is correct. Option 2 is the clearly intended incorrect statement.
